papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.authors: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang, Feiyang Duan, Qingyuan Cao, Yonghui Niu, Sihang Yuan, Ge Zhang, Caifeng Shan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual grounding, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, Nankai University, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出了OmniAssistBench——一个面向全模态大语言模型的助手式交互基准，通过从现有互联网视频中逆向工程构建多轮交互数据集，并利用预定义先验知识固定交互路径，系统评估模型在基础感知和高级目标导向任务中的交互能力。

papers.title: Re$^3$Cap: Retrieval-Guided Refinement for Image Captioning Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Haonan Jia, Shichao Dong, Zenghui Sun, Jiawen Zheng, Ziqi Miao, Gege Shi, Qiuyu Zhao, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng
papers.tags: image captioning, multimodal learning, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: Taobao & Tmall Group of Alibaba; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文提出Re$^3$Cap，一种基于多模态检索引导的强化学习推理策略，通过检索结果中的k-core子图分析来识别图像描述中的幻觉和遗漏，引导LVLMs生成更准确、更详细的图像描述，在无需额外标注的情况下超越监督微调的性能。

papers.title: When Adaptation Hurts: Connecting Representational Drift to OOD Failures in MedSAM Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Marko Haralović, Sounic Akkaraju, Carlo Baretta, Vasil Zapryanov, Alexia Briassouli
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: University of Zagreb, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing, Zagreb, Croatia; University of Twente, Enschede, The Netherlands
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了六种MedSAM微调策略在提示噪声和域偏移下的表现，发现全量微调提供最佳权衡，而仅编码器LoRA是最强的参数高效替代方案，并通过CKA分析揭示远OOD性能退化与解码器表示漂移密切相关。

papers.title: The Coastline as a Structural Constraint: Harnessing Scene Geometry for Autonomous Surface Vessel Localization
papers.authors: Derek R. Benham, Joshua G. Mangelson
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, pose estimation, autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: Brigham Young University, Provo, UT 84602 USA
papers.intro: 本文提出两种利用海岸线和水面几何结构进行GPS拒止环境下自主水面舰艇全局定位的框架——基于LiDAR的管线（结合水面平面估计与跨视角海岸线配准）和基于单目视觉的管线（利用语义分割提取海岸线与地平线，通过层次化因子图实现长期有界漂移定位）。

papers.title: On the Transferability of Agricultural Weed Detection Under Cross-Field Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Nikhilesh Prabhakar, Pranuthi Tenali, Wilfredo Abudeye Fernandez, Shekhar Borah, Athresh Karanam, Erik Blasch, Prabha Sundaravadivel, Sriraam Natarajan
papers.tags: object detection
papers.affiliations: The University of Texas at Dallas, The University of Texas at Tyler, Air Force Research Lab
papers.intro: 本文通过引入新收集的棉花田UAV杂草检测数据集，系统比较了无监督领域自适应目标检测与领域邻近源预训练加少样本微调在跨作物杂草检测迁移中的表现，发现仅需25个标注目标样本的少样本微调即可超越无监督DAOD方法。

papers.title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Zhuoyuan Li, Rui Zhao, Jin Wang, Hanwei Zhu, Cong Zhang, Giuseppe Valenzise, Weisi Lin, Kin-Man Lam
papers.tags: multimodal learning, autonomous driving, object detection, image generation
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Nanyang Technological University; Bytedance Inc.; Shandong University; Université Paris-Saclay
papers.intro: 本文提出Action-JND，将经典的人类视觉系统JND理论扩展到具身感知领域，通过定义语言条件下的机器人行动响应来量化视觉token的可容忍变化边界，并据此开发轻量级token级JND估计器，为VLA模型的token压缩（包括KV缓存复用和token剪枝）提供即插即用的行动容忍度评分准则。

papers.title: A VLM Answer Is Not an Anomaly Score: Rank Compression in Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Inpyo Song, Jangwon Lee
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, CLIP
papers.affiliations: SungKyunKwan University, South Korea
papers.intro: 论文系统研究了VLM-based无训练视频异常检测中"答案接口"（答案尺度与读出规则）对检测性能的影响，证明概率读出（PROB）在所有测试条件下都优于生成式读出（GEN），并揭示了生成式读出因排名压缩导致性能下降的机制。

papers.title: Anchoring Instruction Outside Mask: Exact Reference Caching for Efficient In-Context Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Yangshuai Liu, Zheming Li, Jiaao Li, Kang He, Ziliang Lai, Zhitai Liu, Chengru Song
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology; KlingAI Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种超越掩码设计的静态文本锚点方法，通过重新设计token序列和注意力图，使参考K/V缓存既具备指令感知能力又保持精确可复用性，并采用两阶段蒸馏（教师强制速度蒸馏+在线策略蒸馏）恢复架构转换带来的质量损失，在三个图像编辑基准上匹配全注意力生成质量的同时实现3.92×至5.47×的加速。

papers.title: ES-VP : Energy-Shaped Dynamic Visual Prompting for Efficient Model Adaptation
papers.authors: Can Jin, Ying Li, Jingchen Sun, Hongwu Peng, Jiahui Zhao, Yang Zhou, Lei Li, Dimitris N. Metaxas
papers.tags: vision transformer, image classification, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Rutgers University, Zhejiang University, University at Buffalo (SUNY), Adobe Research, University of Connecticut, Washington University
papers.intro: ES-VP提出了一种基于能量引导的动态视觉提示方法，通过低秩初始化生成通用提示，并利用预训练模型的能量函数为每张图像生成参数自由的动态调整，在显著减少参数量的同时实现了超越现有SOTA方法的性能。

papers.title: Towards Investigating Residual Hearing Loss: Quantification of Fibrosis in a Novel Cochlear OCT Dataset
papers.authors: Julia Dietlmeier, Benjamin Greenberg, Wenxuan He, Teresa Wilson, Rubing Xing, Jordan Hill, Adrienne Fettig, Madeline Otto, Teyhana Rounsavill, Lina A. J. Reiss, Jingang Yi, Noel E. O'Connor, George W. S. Burwood
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: Dublin City University（Julia Dietlmeier, Noel E. O'Connor）；Rutgers University（Benjamin Greenberg, Jingang Yi）；Oregon Health & Science University（Wenxuan He, Teresa Wilson, Rubing Xing, Jordan Hill, Adrienne Fettig, Madeline Otto, Teyhana Rounsavill, Lina A. J. Reiss, George W. S. Burwood）
papers.intro: 本文构建了首个包含CI诱导的耳蜗内纤维化的OCT标注数据集，并提出一种改进的2D-OCT-UNET架构，在多种语义分割模型中取得了最佳性能，实现了对耳蜗纤维化负担的可靠自动量化。

papers.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
papers.authors: Yudong Jin, Tao Xie, Qihang Zhang, Zehong Shen, Zhen Xu, Yujun Shen, Hujun Bao, Xiaowei Zhou, Yinghao Xu
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, video generation, diffusion model, pose estimation
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（State Key Lab of CAD&CG）、Robbyant、香港中文大学、蚂蚁集团、香港科技大学
papers.intro: 4DAnyone提出了一种从无标定单目视频重建4D人体的框架，通过参考上下文打包（RCP）和目标上下文路由（TCR）两种互补设计，解决了视频扩散模型在重建规模下多视角一致性崩溃的问题，实现了重建级多视角视频生成并成功提升为4D高斯泼溅模型。

papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.authors: Hengyuan Xu, Qixun Wang, Yiji Cheng, Miles Yang, Zhao Zhong, Wei Cheng, Xingjun Ma, Yu-gang Jiang
papers.tags: image generation, pose estimation
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, Hunyuan/Tencent, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: WithEveryone是一个统一的框架，通过交错的身份与布局推理、结构化布局思维链（Layout CoT）和布局锚定的身份损失（LG-ID Loss），实现了最多十个参考身份的高质量群体图像生成，在身份相似度和减少复制粘贴伪影方面超越了GPT-Image 2等专有系统。

papers.title: Swift-Image: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.authors: Taihang Hu, Zhao Wang, Zuan Gao, Tao Liu, Hao Yan, Zhengze Xu, Yuhang Yu, Yongchao Du, Xingjian Wang, Jun Zheng, Qinye Zhou, Zhengrui Chen, Chao Lin, Yefeng Shen, Zhengtao Wu, Ge Wu, Xiaoli Xu, Denghui Yang, Huayu Zhang, Mingzhou Zhang, Mengting Chen
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group
papers.intro: Swift-Image提出了一套系统化的训练工程流水线（包括渐进式预训练、并行专家强化学习、多教师蒸馏、结构剪枝和少步蒸馏），在仅6B参数和243K GPU训练小时下实现了领先的统一图像生成与编辑性能，并提供了3B压缩变体和少步加速变体。

papers.title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.authors: Yufei Liu, Xixi Wang, Hao Li, Ganlong Zhao, Kaitong Cai, Chengkai Jin, Chunxiao Liu, Jianbo Liu, Siyuan Huang, Xingang Pan, Hongsheng Li
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, video generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, ACE Robotics
papers.intro: DreamHand将预训练视频扩散模型重新定位为确定性几何编码器，通过单次前向传播提取遮挡和视野外手部的场景内容，结合双向时空解码器和基于射线的相机求解器，实现了无需外部检测器和测试时相机内参的遮挡鲁棒性第一人称3D双手运动恢复。

papers.title: Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention for Hierarchical Feature Modulation toward Anatomy-Agnostic Segmentation
papers.authors: Mosharof Hossain, Md Rabiul Islam, Limon Halder, Erchin Serpedin, Md Kamrul Hasan
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET), Texas A&M University, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种名为Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention (PCCA)的新型提示条件通道注意力机制，通过层级化地将语义提示集成到编码器-解码器分割网络中，实现了跨架构、跨模态和跨解剖目标的通用医学图像分割框架PROMISE-Net。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Workflow Analysis in Colorectal Surgery: A Multicentric, Cross-Procedural Development and Generalization Study
papers.authors: Pietro Mascagni, Julia Alekseenko, Pooja P Jain, Marta Goglia, Andrea Balla, Ludovica Baldari, Gianfranco Silecchia, Claudio Fiorillo, Vincenzo Tondolo, Salvador Morales-Conde, Luigi Boni, Sergio Alfieri, Nicolas Padoy
papers.tags: video segmentation, vision transformer, image classification
papers.affiliations: IHU Strasbourg, Strasbourg, France; Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, Italy; Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Rome, Italy; University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, UMR7357, France; Sapienza University of Rome, Italy; University Hospital Virgen Macarena, University of Sevilla, Seville, Spain; Fondazione IRCCS - Ca' Granda - Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico di Milano, Milan, Italy; Ospedale Isola Tiberina–Gemelli Isola, Rome, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出AI-ColoWorkflow，一个结合微调DINOv3视觉Transformer和层次化多阶段时序卷积网络的深度学习模型，能够基于统一共识本体论自动识别微创结直肠手术的阶段和步骤，并证明在多中心、多术式数据上训练的单一模型在阶段识别上优于或至少不逊于中心/术式特定模型。

papers.title: DPC-Net: Dual-Prior Collaborative Network for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.authors: Zhaokun He, Kangbiao Shi, Axi Niu, Jian Jin, Peng Wu, Wei Dong, Qingsen Yan
papers.tags: diffusion model, multimodal learning, image generation
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Singapore Management University, Xi'an University of Architecture and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种双先验协同网络（DPC-Net），通过联合利用退化-语义耦合先验和低层视觉先验，在全合一图像恢复任务中实现了高质量、结构一致且语义连贯的图像重建。

papers.title: Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training
papers.authors: Joonas Järve, Halil Ibrahim Aysel, Tarun Khajuria, Meelis Kull
papers.tags: vision transformer, image classification, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Tartu
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的epoch-by-layer二维框架，用于追踪ViT训练过程中视觉特征的演化与迁移，揭示了特征迁移主要集中在训练早期、深层特征比浅层特征更早且更强烈地稳定等关键发现。

papers.title: ArmorOCR: Grounded Adversarial Visual Perception via Observation-Transferred Self-Distillation
papers.authors: Linhan Cao, Siyuan Li, Jun Lan, Liangbo He, Guannan Li, Xiaolei Huang, Jun Jia, Shuheng Zhou, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Wei Sun
papers.tags: multimodal learning, OCR, visual grounding, object detection
papers.affiliations: Ant Group, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, East China Normal University
papers.intro: 本文提出了AdvSpot——首个用于接地对抗性OCR感知评估的基准，以及ArmorOCR——一个两阶段训练框架，通过观察转移自蒸馏（OPSD）和任务条件GRPO强化学习，将变换揭示的感知信息内化到模型参数中，实现单次前向推理的鲁棒对抗性OCR感知。

papers.title: Flow Matching-Based PET Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fumio Hashimoto, Ziqian Huang, Tatsuya Yokota, Kuang Gong
papers.tags: diffusion model, medical image, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Florida; Nagoya Institute of Technology; RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
papers.intro: 本文提出基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的PET图像重建方法，通过将流匹配生成先验与PET数据一致性约束在近似贝叶斯框架下分离，实现了高效、稳定且定量准确的PET图像重建。
